content:
BUILT CoLAB was present at Tektonika 2023 – International Construction Fair, which took place between May 4th and 7th in Lisbon.

Lurdes Laranjeira, BUILT CoLAB’s Marketing & Communication Officer, represented REV@CONSTRUCTION, as the entity responsible for the project’s communication, when she made her pitch in the TekTalks space in the Fair’s auditorium, and had the opportunity to present the objectives and some of the results already achieved to the audience.

The project was also present at the event with a stand, where Marco Pedroso and Pedro Lucas Martins from BUILT CoLAB had the opportunity to speak to the public and present the project to interested parties.

It was also an opportunity for networking between the project’s co-promoters, with visits from Rita Moura, from Teixeira Duarte, the project’s leader, and Paula Couto, from LNEC, who is taking part in PPS1.
